facts.fact: Ghana told the CRPD Committee that the Persons with Disability Act 2006 is under review and the Persons with Disabilities Bill 2024 has article 48 requiring ICT service providers and public information providers to make services accessible, in formats including braille and Ghanaian sign language.
Ghana says the Ghana Digital Acceleration Project, running to 2027, prioritizes upgrading government e-portals to meet accessibility requirements for persons with disabilities.
Ghana says the National Communication Authority, in its move to digital terrestrial television, has taken measures to make GTV news broadcasts accessible to the deaf.
facts.system: GTV news broadcasts on digital terrestrial television
